principles: Reuse B-40eb's canonical gate as-is; only wire it into CI, do not change its rules.
Narrow scope: only the 7 mkdtemp prefixes plus the package.json wiring.
Continuous enforcement: the gate must run on every lattice validate so regressions are caught.
Order matters: clean residuals first, then wire, so npm test never goes red mid-story.
drivers: Make koala-residue a permanent gate before OSS so branding cannot silently re-enter.
Keep the gate green on main by cleaning the 7 known residuals.
Do not disturb B-40eb's documented exceptions or the completed full sweep.

options.name: A: wire via the package.json test chain
pros: Simplest wiring; lattice validate already uses npm test as its fallback battery
Minimal moving parts; one script entry
cons: Runs as part of the whole test suite rather than a first-class standalone validate plugin

options.name: B: configured validate.command / dedicated validate plugin
cons: Heavier, more moving parts, not needed for a single gate script

options.name: C: leave the gate unwired (manual only)
cons: No continuous enforcement; regressions slip in, defeating the purpose of story 4

chosen: A: wire via the package.json test chain
rationale: The package.json test chain is the simplest continuous-gate wiring; lattice validate already runs npm test as its fallback battery, so adding test:koala-residue makes the gate run on every validate with minimal moving parts. Option B is heavier than a single gate script needs; option C provides no continuous enforcement and defeats the story's purpose.

preMortem.scenario: Renaming a koala-* mkdtemp prefix breaks a test that asserts on the temp-dir name
preMortem.trigger: the prefix is referenced or asserted elsewhere in the smoke
preMortem.mitigation: mkdtemp prefixes are local temp-dir names, not assertion targets; run both smokes after the rename to confirm they still pass

preMortem.scenario: Wiring test:koala-residue makes npm test fail because residuals are not yet cleaned
preMortem.trigger: CHK-002 (wire) done before CHK-001 (clean) removes all hits
preMortem.consequence: npm test / lattice validate goes red
preMortem.mitigation: clean the 7 residuals first (CHK-001), confirm the gate PASSes, then wire (CHK-002); verify gate green before wiring

preMortem.scenario: The gate finds MORE residue on main than the known 7 (other stories landed new koala since the inventory)
preMortem.consequence: gate red after wiring, blocking unrelated stories' validate
preMortem.mitigation: re-run the gate on the current worktree base; clean any additional koala-* brand prefixes found (or document as exception); ensure PASS before wiring

preMortem.scenario: The gate's git-tracked/staged scope misses untracked new files, giving a false green in CI
preMortem.consequence: a new untracked koala file could pass CI until committed
preMortem.mitigation: document the git-tracked/staged scope limitation in the summary; acceptable for CI since untracked files are not committed; note as a possible follow-up enhancement
